description: No taxation without representation! Missouri's 95th State House District has been unrepresented for months since our previous representative quit on his first day. We deserve better! Vote Meredith Sumenek for State Representative in District 95 in South St. Louis County.

title: Representation — Meredith Sumenek for Missouri
